scope: Current unchanged live transport local source contract, all canonical category IDs and exact node/scope/span linkage.
groups: LV01
Import bridge interfaces; transport version 1.3.0; source-only review.
LV02
Require E engine and S enabled, exact int positive timeframe. Copy args; retain engine bundle and fresh buckets/views.
LV03
Append validates int conversion equality and positive time, nondecreasing versus previous bucket raw time (equal allowed). Empty initial history raises.
LV04
Copy args and set to_time; 2 directions if primary exists or both requested else 1. Progress callback increments completed stages with total direction_count+4; started emitted before try.
LV05

Bucket staged append context passes delta and retained views to native calculation; final validation-ready progress inside context. BaseException resets views and reraises; bucket rollback delegated. Return payload only on successful context exit.
LV06
Two ValueError subclasses distinguish changed lineage and unproved delta. JSON decoding uses Decimal for floats, requires nonempty list, no per-row validation here.
LV07
Bisect original by first selected time; compare selected to slice unless same object; keep original suffix as catchup, original last time, then remember prefix.
LV08
Find last closing bracket, hash bytes strictly before it, retain ending; digest copies hash then updates ending.
LV09

Require base digest match and leading comma; hash proposed appended bytes against retained ending, compare target digest, decode bracketed delta. Call pipeline first, update prefix/end/current digest only on success.
LV10

Full append requires length beyond prefix and exact prefix digest. lstrip tail, decode comma suffix or allow only closing bracket with trailing whitespace; other tail raises. After pipeline succeeds, remember prefix if rows else update changed ending/digest only.
LV11
New raw times strictly greater than original last time, unlike low-level nondecreasing gate. Send catchup + new rows; clear catchup and advance last time only after successful pipeline.
LV12
Compact flushed JSON worker messages; fields follow type and may override it. Progress forwarded if started or completedStages present.
LV13

Read selected/original path according to env; same path reuses data and decoded list. Construct lineage and pipeline; send seed ready and payload from selected rows. Release references; stdin binary transport.
LV14
Read at most 256 header bytes; require newline. Parse JSON, exact positive int bytes, string digest length 64; read exact bytes. Only progress is True enables progress sink.
LV15

Scoped progress sink; non-null base digest selects delta route. Delta mismatch sends RAW_DELTA_MISMATCH and continues. Full digest mismatch sends RAW_RETRY and continues; otherwise full append. Successful update sends payload.
LV16
LiveRawChanged => RAW_CHANGED and return1; other Exception logs stderr, LIVE_ENGINE_FAILED and return1. Normal exit0; module sys.exit(main()).

dependencies.evidence: CP293 market context, CP299 live response, CP300 loader/progress, CP307 CLI and engine bundle, CP308 local closure
dependencies.contract: Native bucket stage rollback, market view invalidation, calculation and progress are delegated; transport commits lineage only after successful append.

limits: No RAW reads, no runtime imports, no benchmark, no independent full AST regeneration. Call target declarations checked through current v5 and identity crosswalk; no runtime dispatch proof.
